description: This PHP source file defines the BasicUserRoleManager class, which manages user roles and permissions within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It implements role-based access control features, including checking entity accessibility, workflow actions, and module permissions, and initializes role classes for different user types.

classes.name: BasicUserRoleManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing user roles and permissions, including role initialization, permission checks, and role filtering within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes role classes with predefined mappings for different user roles.

methods.name: getUserRoleClass
methods.description: Retrieves the class instance associated with a given role name.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ScreenPermissionService instance.

methods.name: setScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Sets the ScreenPermissionService instance.

methods.name: getHomePageDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the HomePageDao instance.

methods.name: setHomePageDao
methods.description: Sets the HomePageDao instance.

methods.name: getAccessFlowStateMachineService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the AccessFlowStateMachineService instance.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntities
methods.description: Retrieves entities accessible by the user based on roles and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of entities accessible by the user.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of entities accessible by the user.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is allowed within a workflow for the user.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of actions the user is allowed to perform in a workflow.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Determines possible states the user can transition to with specified actions in a workflow.

methods.name: getUniqueActionsBasedOnPriority
methods.description: Merges workflow actions, prioritizing higher priority actions.

methods.name: isEntityAccessible
methods.description: Checks if a specific entity instance is accessible to the user.

methods.name: areEntitiesAccessible
methods.description: Checks if multiple entities are accessible to the user.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Retrieves employees assigned to a specific role.

methods.name: getAccessibleModules
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to retrieve modules accessible to the user.

methods.name: isModuleAccessible
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to check access to a specific module.

methods.name: isScreenAccessible
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to check access to a specific screen.

methods.name: isFieldAccessible
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to check access to a specific field.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions for a specific screen within a module.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves API permissions based on class name.

methods.name: computeUserRoles
methods.description: Computes the list of roles associated with a user based on various criteria.

methods.name: mergeEmployees
methods.description: Combines employee lists ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: areRequiredPermissionsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the user has the required permissions.

methods.name: filterRoles
methods.description: Filters roles based on inclusion and exclusion lists, and attributes like supervision.

methods.name: fixUserRoleNameForWorkflowStateMachine
methods.description: Adjusts role names for workflow state machine compatibility.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Fetches permissions for data groups applicable to the user's roles.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of data group permissions with filtering options.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Determines the default page for a module based on user roles and enabling conditions.

methods.name: getHomePage
methods.description: Determines the home page for the user based on roles and activation conditions.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Provides a list of accessible quick launch items for the user.
